name: Partition Testing
description: Test sync under network partitions, message reordering, duplication, and delay. Jepsen-style verification.
purpose: Validate sync correctness under adversarial network conditions — partitions, reordering, duplication, and delay — using Jepsen-style verification.
acceptanceCriteria: Test harness can simulate network partitions, message reordering, duplication, and delay.
Each test starts from a known initial state, applies concurrent mutations, then heals the partition and verifies convergence.
Causal consistency invariants are checked: no operation applied before its dependencies.
Convergence invariant: all devices eventually reach the same state under quiet conditions.
Idempotency invariant: replaying operations never diverges state from a replay without partitions.
Tests are repeatable and produce a minimal counterexample on failure.
